skills.name: Demand for and supply of money

note.text: Demand for money means the balances people wish to hold, not every desire for higher income. Transactions balances support expected payments; precautionary balances address uncertainty. Portfolio choice also compares liquid money with other assets, taking risk, liquidity and the opportunity cost of forgone returns into account. Money supply is a defined stock at a point in time. Its measure depends on which currency and deposit categories are included. Do not add a flow of annual income to a money stock as if they measured the same thing.

sections.heading: Your goal and connections
sections.text: By the end, you should be able to explain why balances are held and distinguish a money stock from income flows. Builds on: money forms and functions. Leads to: value of money, inflation and bank deposit creation.

sections.heading: Understand the economics
sections.text: Demand for money means the balances people wish to hold, not every desire for higher income. Transactions balances support expected payments; precautionary balances address uncertainty. Portfolio choice also compares liquid money with other assets, taking risk, liquidity and the opportunity cost of forgone returns into account. Money supply is a defined stock at a point in time. Its measure depends on which currency and deposit categories are included. Do not add a flow of annual income to a money stock as if they measured the same thing.

sections.heading: Follow the local case
sections.text: An imaginary Buea trader keeps a balance for routine suppliers and a separate cushion for uncertain expenses. Another household compares a liquid balance with a less liquid asset. These cases explain motives without prescribing a financial choice. The class counts a narrowly defined money stock comprising currency held by the public and specified transferable deposits, avoiding double counting bank vault cash.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Identify whether a figure is a stock at a date or a flow during a period. For demand, name the reason for holding balances. State the definition before adding components; the lesson supplies no actual Cameroon monetary total or current interest rate.

questions.prompt: In an invented narrow measure, public currency is {c} CFA francs and included transferable deposits are {d}. They do not overlap. Find the money stock.

misconceptions.explain: That omits the included deposit balances.
The non-overlapping included categories are added, not netted against each other.

solution: Use only the categories included in this defined stock.
